text:
incident-bot: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate detected on /v1/ingest -> gateway cluster (us-west-2). 5m error rate 11.8% (baseline 0.3%). Primary error types: 504 gateway timeout, upstream egress timeout. Pager: carla (oncall). Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/gateway-egress-timeouts

carla (oncall): I'm oncall. digging in now. any obvious customer impact?

derek (product): Some API customers are seeing request failures and increased page reloads. Support ticket queue is seeing a ~3x spike. No major customers (>500k qps) reported full outage yet, but severity is rising.

ben (eng-runtime): looking at gateway logs — we have a spike in backend connection timeouts to payment-processor.svc.cluster.local:443. backend responds with no data, infra shows TCP RST / no HTTP response. egress error count spiking across 3 AZs.

anna (sre): quick check: are traces showing any egress spans? I'm not seeing spans for payment-processor calls in the last 20m. could be that tracer sampling dropped or headers stripped by upstream proxy.

carla (oncall): ops-bot, can you surface any recent config changes that would affect tracing or proxy headers?

ops-bot: Recent commits (last 1h) to gateway-config: removed `proxy_forwarded_for` flag in PR #4123 (deployed 08:52 UTC). Also config-service reported a sampling-rate modification to 0.0 for service:gateway at 08:50:12 UTC.

ben (eng-runtime): ok that explains missing spans. we also see the gateway worker pool exhausted due to retries waiting on egress sockets. first mitigation: reduce retries and fail fast, and re-enable tracing sampling. I can patch gateway config to `max_retries: 1` and `egress_timeout: 6s` to cut tail latency.

anna (sre): I'll flip tracing sampling to 100% for 15m to capture a full picture and add debug logs for egress.

carla (oncall): do it. also add a request-id header injection at ingress if possible so we can stitch logs even while spans are absent.

ben (eng-runtime): preparing quick patch. commands I'll run:

```
# reduce retries and timeout
kubectl -n prod patch configmap gateway-config -p '{"data":{"max_retries":"1","egress_timeout":"6s"}}'
# force reload
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deployment/gateway
```

and to re-enable tracing sampling:

```
curl -X POST "https://config-service.internal/api/v1/flags" -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' -d '{"service":"gateway","tracing_sample_rate":1.0}'
```

anna (sre): I'm running the config-service call now. once tracing is up I'll ramp up the tracer logs.

ops-bot: config change applied: tracing_sample_rate=1.0 for service gateway (applied by anna) at 08:58:13 UTC.

ben (eng-runtime): patch applied to gateway-config, rollout started. patch id: r1234. Waiting for pods to come back.

carla (oncall): Support, please post a short customer-facing note in the support channel: "We are investigating increased errors on API routes, mitigation in progress". No need to external notify yet until we confirm scope.

support (via DM): noted, posting now.

anna (sre): Tracing check: I can now see spans with egress entries — but span attributes show upstream TLS handshake timeouts and no response body. Sampling confirms 100% capture for recent requests.

ben (eng-runtime): looking at tcpdump on gateway egress: seeing SYN retransmits to payment-processor IPs, then RSTs from the remote side. Could be downstream vendor degraded. Opening vendor status page now.

derek (product): pinged vendor SRE (payment-ops) — they acknowledge partial degradation in the region and are investigating. ETA unknown. They advise fallback routing to alternative payment cluster in eu-west if feasible.

carla (oncall): fallback routing is risky for consistency but worth a try for reducing 5xx. Ben, can we add a routing rule to prefer eu-west for new requests while we monitor?

ben (eng-runtime): I can add a temporary routing policy in envoy for backend:

```
# temp routing override
kubectl -n prod patch configmap envoy-routes -p '{"data":{"payment_backend_prefer":"eu-west"}}'
kubectl -n prod rollout restart daemonset/envoy
```

This will bias new connections to eu-west. It will take a minute to propagate.

anna (sre): also adding a stopgap instrumentation: inject X-Redwood-Req-ID at ingress if not present so logs can be correlated across retries. snippet to add in ingress template: `proxy_set_header X-Redwood-Req-ID $request_id;`

carla (oncall): good. ensure the change is low-risk and revertible. Keep me posted on impact to error rate.

ops-bot: envoy rollout completed (target 24/24 pods) at 09:04:05 UTC.

ben (eng-runtime): initial metrics after routing change: 5xx rate dropped from 11.8% -> 6.2% within 45s. latency tail also improving. Looks promising.

anna (sre): traces show successful egress to eu-west, spans present and full. We captured several failure traces to payment-processor showing TLS handshake errors to the us-west IPs — confirms vendor-side connectivity issues.

carla (oncall): great mitigation. keeping tracing at 100% for another 10m to ensure no regression. Ben, keep routing override in place until vendor confirms recovery.

ben (eng-runtime): will keep override and prepare rollback script. rollback command:

```
kubectl -n prod patch configmap envoy-routes -p '{"data":{"payment_backend_prefer":""}}'
kubectl -n prod rollout restart daemonset/envoy
```

anna (sre): adding follow-up ticket to fix observability gap: ensure tracer sampling flags aren't globally lowered by config-service commits and add CI guard for proxy header removal. created ticket PLATFORM-3789.

carla (oncall): handoff: I'm off-shift in 20m. Anna will take over monitoring. Anna, confirm you accept handoff and estimated follow-up steps for the morning.

anna (sre): I accept. follow-ups: revert temp routing after vendor resolves and confirm end-to-end transactions; harden tracer config; add automated alerts for sudden sampling-rate changes; add runtime check to ensure X-Redwood-Req-ID present on ingress. I'll update postmortem template with timeline and instrumentation lag.

carla (oncall): thanks. I'll update incident channel and add incident label. moving to watch mode. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident state changed -> mitigated (partial) at 09:07:14 UTC. Monitoring for regression.

anna (sre): leaving detailed notes in runbook and tagging PLATFORM-3789 and SUPPORT-5421 in the postmortem.

carla (oncall): closing handoff to anna at 09:09:00 UTC.
